messages:
Lina (AE): Heads up - FluxGate wants to run a POC to move off CompetitorQ. Key asks: alignment with current prompts, function-call parity (webhooks), token accounting, and enterprise gating items. Need SE + Security triage.

Omar (SE): I'll take lead. Quick tech note: CompetitorQ uses 'chat' that returns message parts under choices[].message and occasionally returns delta chunks with role annotations. Redwood returns SSE chunks with `delta` fields; shim required.

Priya Ops: They want short-lived Hosted POC but will require IP allowlist and SSO. Also asked about ability to pause logging for specific endpoints.

Kato ML: Prompt parity: they use a post-reranker step that reorders candidate outputs; that might hide simple top-1 differences. Recommend including reranker in the POC harness or disabling it for fairness.

Sam (Security): Security questionnaire incoming. If they insist on no plaintext logs, we must use Dedicated/Private. Which approach for interim?

Omar (SE): Example shim recommended for their devs: 
```
# competitorQ -> redwood streaming shim
curl -N "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-7b-chat" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"${prompt}"}],"stream":true}'
```
Map: competitor 'delta.role' -> redwood 'delta.role', competitor 'finish_reason' -> redwood 'finish_reason'.

Lina (AE): Pricing: they asked if we can offer an onboarding credit and whether Dedicated has minimum term. pricing-bot?

pricing-bot: Hosted -> per-token. Onboarding credits are approved by Rev Ops; Dedicated has 12-mo minimum commit for reserved capacity.

Kato ML: Also note CompetitorQ applies a latency-based early-stopping heuristic that truncates long outputs at 512 tokens. We should test long-output cases to ensure parity.

Priya Ops: POC acceptance checklist draft: 1) 150 evaluation prompts, 2) top-1 match >= 92% after reranker normalization, 3) token variance < 9%, 4) SSO + IP allowlist, 5) logging policy verified.

Sam (Security): I'll send baseline docs (SOC2, data-processing addendum) and ask legal if they need a DPA w/ EU data residency clause.

Omar (SE): I'll push the shim + eval harness to repo fluxgate-poc and run an initial smoke against 50 prompts. Expect results by EOD.

Lina (AE): Thanks. I'll book an all-hands with FluxGate tomorrow 3pm PST.
